name: MIIT (China)
sub: Drafting China's first mandatory ADS standard, effective Jul 2027
about: Drafting China's first mandatory national ADS safety standard. A 2026 draft mandatory standard would require L3 systems to execute a minimal-risk maneuver themselves if the driver fails to respond, an L4-level fallback, and to carry an aircraft-style data recorder, proposed to take effect July 1, 2027.
signal: Draft mandatory L3/L4 standard effective Jul 2027 (Feb 2026)
